children: Stock-specific action remained in focus on Dalal Street on September 4, with investors reacting to corporate developments.

Shares of Shanthi Gears jumped 5% after board appointed Sai Krishna Alluri as the Chief Financial Officer of the company with immediate effect. Consequently, Sukanta Kumar Panigrahi has ceased to be the Interim CFO of the company.

Share price of Cohance Lifesciences rose on announcing two proposed transactions to strengthen its antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) strategy – an additional investment of $13 million in NJ Bio and a controlling investment of $5 million in Aruka Bio. Both transactions will be funded through internal accruals.

Shares of Avalon Technologies advanced after company with Zollner Elektronik AG, a leading European electronics manufacturing services company, have announced the formation of a joint venture (JV) for PCBA, box-build and system-integration manufacturing in India.

WeWork India share price added 3% after board has given in-principle approval for setting up a 10 MWp captive solar power plant in Karnataka, aimed at reducing the company’s electricity costs, increasing the use of renewable energy and supporting its sustainability objectives.
Among sectors, Nifty IT rose nearly 1%, while pharma index down 0.5%.
The broader market traded higher, with the Nifty Midcap index up 0.2% and the Smallcap index added 0.5%.
However, market breadth on the BSE remained weak, with 2076 shares advancing, 1091 declining and 182 unchanged, suggesting a mixed trend beneath the headline gains.

title: Price Action: WeWork India rises 3% on solar plant approval; Shanthi Gears jumps 5% after CFO appointment
